LightningComponentBundle.description: Guest-site host (Phase A2): fetches a published form's projected spec via the guarded guest controller and renders it through the final* viewer. Place on a public LWR Experience Cloud page.

property.name: formId
property.label: Form Id
property.description: The published form to render. A ?formId= (or ?c__formId=) URL parameter overrides this, so one host page can serve any form.
